rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core design: a Cox model with a standardized continuous score plus condition, a Schoenfeld PH check with a time-varying remedy, event-count flags for thin strata, and tertile Kaplan-Meier curves demoted to supportive display after the model; the interaction model is a reasonable addition. Normalization is explicit (median-of-ratios size factors plus VST, with a rank-based secondary score), signature-gene overlap is reported with named missing genes, and event coding and sample joins are asserted. It falls short on QC (only size-factor summaries; no PCA or sample-distance check with an outlier policy), never mentions a low-count filter before VST, and omits the up-front event/censoring count and median follow-up that the reference uses to frame power. Package versions are not requested in the report.
